title: The Pastry War: A Port Bombarded Over a Baker's Bill
summary: This episode tells how the complaint of Remontel, a French pastry cook seeking compensation for his looted shop in Mexico, turned in 1838 into the French navy's blockade of Veracruz and its bombardment of the fortress of San Juan de Ulúa. The story reaches Santa Anna, who lost his leg in the counterattack and turned that wound into political capital, and the state funeral he held for his leg in 1842.
